convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for 'Karpenko' indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all position open/close logic, money management, and new bar detection. Custom indicator cannot be auto-converted without reverse-engineering the Karpenko indicator source.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: Signal reversal: when Ind crosses below Sign, existing long is closed; when Ind crosses above Sign, existing short is closed. BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input flags control whether opposite-signal closes are enabled.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (MM parameter as lot), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM=0.1 acts as either lot size or risk fraction depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses two buffers from the custom Karpenko indicator: buffer 0 (Ind, likely main line) and buffer 1 (Sign, likely signal line). Entry signals use previous completed bar values (index [1]) for trend direction and one bar before that (index [0] relative to SignalBar=1, i.e. 2 bars ago) for crossover detection. When SignalBar=0, the EA evaluates on every tick instead of only on new bars. The LoadHistory call ensures sufficient bar data is loaded. Signal timestamps are constructed from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for position tracking. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans independently gate each trade action, allowing partial strategy configuration (e.g., long-only, close-only mode).
python_conversion_notes: The Karpenko custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python before the strategy can be backtested. The two-buffer crossover logic (Ind vs Sign) is straightforward once indicator values are available. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh money management functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_) need Python equivalents. Position sizing supports 5 modes via MarginMode enum - implement all or default to fixed lot (LOT mode). The new bar guard and SignalBar logic allow both per-bar and per-tick evaluation modes. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - the values 1000/2000 likely need digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers (effective 100/200 pips on 5-digit, 1000/2000 pips on 4-digit). Verify whether TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles digit adjustment internally.
